claims.statement: Exploring a specific security feature's alert page and using feature-specific filters is optional. A filtered view is not an exhaustive alert census, evidence of no findings, scanner health, permission completeness or a completed review.

The organization security tab label resolves through product.prodname_security_and_quality_tab: Security and quality in the pinned FPT/GHEC feature branch, Security otherwise, with a shield icon. This naming distinction is navigation, not scanner activation, evaluated controls, accessible alert data or observed security posture.
Authentication security is reached under the Security sidebar. It does not prove enabled 2FA, SAML configuration, secure credential state, changed policy or effective enforcement.

The submission action is Send invitation in FPT/GHEC and Add member otherwise. Submission-label differences are not actual invitation delivery/acceptance, membership or a granted role; no person was invited or added.

The custom-images wrapper includes the inspected Actions settings fragment, which leads through Actions to Custom images. Navigation is not available image inventory, authorized image provenance, runner allocation, image publication, installed workload or spending approval; no image or runner changed.

The general-settings wrapper includes the inspected Actions fragment leading through Actions to General. The upstream comment limits that fragment's authoring reuse to other repository/organization/enterprise settings fragments; it is untrusted authoring metadata, not an executable instruction or local governance. Navigation does not establish enabled Actions, selected permissions, allowed workflows or native enforcement.
